name: Live translated video calls
what_it_does: Two people on a video call each speak their own language and read the other's words as live captions in theirs.
pain_removed: Calls where one person nods along without understanding

name: The other person needs nothing
what_it_does: The person you call just taps a link and joins in their browser: no app, no account, no sign-up.
pain_removed: Asking grandma to install an app and make an account

name: Your call card
what_it_does: A personal link anyone can use to call you any time; share it once.
pain_removed: Sending a new link before every call

name: One-tap Call button
what_it_does: The round Call button in the middle of the bar starts a call and gives you the link to send.
pain_removed: Hunting through menus to start a call

name: In person mode
what_it_does: One phone between two people: each speaks their own language and reads the other on their half of the screen.
pain_removed: Passing a phone back and forth with a translate app

name: Their language worked out for them
what_it_does: In person mode works out the other person's language from their first three words and shows it.
pain_removed: Scrolling a list of 60 languages while someone waits

name: Translates how people really talk
what_it_does: Slang, idioms, swearing and terms of endearment come out as the natural equivalent, not word for word, across 60 languages.
pain_removed: Literal translations that turn a joke into nonsense

name: 60 languages
what_it_does: Captions work in 60 languages including Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Mandarin, Vietnamese and Tagalog.
pain_removed: Apps that only cover a handful of big languages

name: Group calls up to 12
what_it_does: Up to 12 people on one call, each reading everyone else in their own language.
pain_removed: Family calls where half the room can't follow

name: In the same room
what_it_does: People sharing a room in a group call are heard once, so captions don't double up.
pain_removed: Echo and duplicated captions when two phones are in one room

name: See what it heard you say
what_it_does: Your own words show briefly as you talk so you can check it heard you right.
pain_removed: Not knowing if the translation started from the right words

name: Scroll back through the conversation
what_it_does: Scroll back to anything said earlier in the call; Latest jumps back to the newest words.
pain_removed: Missing a sentence and having to ask again

name: Keep the conversation
what_it_does: After the call you can save the whole conversation in both languages.
pain_removed: Forgetting the address or the date someone told you

name: Photos and videos in the call
what_it_does: Send photos and videos into the call's chat; they disappear when the call ends.
pain_removed: Switching apps to show someone a picture mid-call

name: Not right? button
what_it_does: Tap Not right? on a line and that one sentence is saved so translations improve.
pain_removed: Bad translations nobody ever fixes

name: It learns your names and words
what_it_does: Save your names, pets, places and nicknames so captions spell them right.
pain_removed: Your partner's name turned into a random word

name: Gets she and he right
what_it_does: Tell it your gender once and languages that need it (Arabic, Russian, Hindi) address you correctly.
pain_removed: Being called the wrong gender in translation

name: Someone's waiting alerts
what_it_does: When someone opens your call card you get a notification and can join.
pain_removed: Missing a call because you didn't know they were waiting

name: Recent and contacts
what_it_does: The people you've called sit on your home screen; one tap calls them again.
pain_removed: Re-sending links to the same people

name: Switch to voice only
what_it_does: Drop to audio only on a weak connection and keep the captions.
pain_removed: Calls freezing on bad internet

name: Nothing lost on slow internet
what_it_does: On a slow or dropped connection your words wait on the phone and are translated when it recovers.
pain_removed: Translations skipped when your Wi-Fi lags

name: Block and report
what_it_does: Block or report someone from inside a call.
pain_removed: Feeling unsafe with a stranger on a call

name: Calls are never recorded
what_it_does: Video and voice go phone to phone; nothing of the call is stored by Simpatico.
pain_removed: Worrying who is listening

name: Move to a new phone
what_it_does: Copy everything to a new phone with one paste.
pain_removed: Losing your contacts when you change phones

name: Captions your way
what_it_does: Choose caption size and whether long speech scrolls or makes room.
pain_removed: Captions covering faces or too small to read

name: Plus and Max plans
what_it_does: Monthly caption hours with a free trial.

name: Their phone joins In person by QR
what_it_does: The other person scans a code to see their half on their own phone.

name: Read translations aloud
what_it_does: Speaks the translation out loud in In person mode.
